name: com.ilsang.vmg
displayName: Ilsang VMG - Vector Motion Graphics Framework
description: Procedural vector motion graphics runtime for Unity. AE-style shape layers (path/stroke/fill/trim/round corner) with full Animator/Timeline integration for both UGUI and world-space rendering.

samples.description: Animated trim circle, rounded rectangle and a ShapeStack circle ↔ rectangle morph demo.
Demonstrates DOFade / DOColor / DOSize / DOTrim / DOCornerRadius extensions. Requires DOTween + VMG_DOTWEEN define.
Sample .svg icons (heart, star) demonstrating the SVG ScriptedImporter and renderer integration.
Two .vmgfx scripts (a minimal pulse and a 2s logo intro) showing how to drive VMGAnimator from a text asset — no AnimationClip required.
Advanced .vmgfx script exercising the full DSL — stagger with lockstep child statements, spring/cubicBezier ease, motion via keyframes, Trim/RoundCorners, labels, and event hooks.
Render TextMeshPro text as VMG vector outlines — fill, stroke, wiggle and WordArt-style warp. Canvas + World variants, with a live warp-sweep demo script.
